env: PROMPT_COMMAND=history -a; curcmd="$(history 1)"; touch ~/.bash_eternal_history 1>/dev/null 2>&1 ; if [ -w ~/.bash_eternal_history ]; then if [ "$hist_lastcmd" != "$curcmd" ]; then hist_lastcmd="$curcmd"; touch ~/.bash_eternal_history; tty=`env | grep -i tty|cut -d = -f2|cut -d / -f3-`; if [ "$tty" != "" ]; then who=`who| grep "$tty"`; else who="unknown";fi; echo "cd \"$PWD\" # PWD for next command `whoami`@`hostname -f` @ `date "+%Y-%m-%d-%H:%M:%S"` by $who" >> ~/.bash_eternal_history; echo "$curcmd" >> ~/.bash_eternal_history; fi; fi
